profile_details.location_finder_confirm_message: {{appName}} can triangulate this profile's position by repeatedly changing your location on the server. This takes a few minutes; your location is restored afterwards.
profile_details.location_finder_confirm_warning: This violates Grindr's terms of service and can get your account banned. Use at your own risk.
profile_details.location_finder_final_location: The user is at approximately lat:{{lat}}, lon:{{lon}}. Estimated error: ~{{error}} meters from the final estimated location.
profile_details.location_finder_error_age_verification_r: Stopped: this profile is in or near a region where Grindr requires age verification. Moving your location there would lock your account.
profile_details.location_finder_region_limited: Accuracy is limited: this profile is in or near a region where Grindr requires age verification, and moving closer would lock your account.
profile_details.location_finder_busy: Locate is already running for another profile.

onboarding.title: Profile Visitors
onboarding.limitation_desc: Grindr normally only shows the very last visitor in full. Others are typically hidden behind a paywall or shown as anonymous previews.
onboarding.recovery_desc: {{appName}} automatically matches anonymous visitors with your local history. If we find a match, the profile will be revealed to you.

entitlement_bypass.prompt_message: {{appName}} can attempt to bypass this by momentarily spoofing your location to Honduras.
entitlement_bypass.prompt_warning: This violates Grindr's terms of service and can get your account banned. Use at your own risk.
entitlement_bypass.reason_expiring_photo: Daily expiring photo limit reached. Sending more requires a Grindr subscription.
entitlement_bypass.reason_message: Sending this message requires a Grindr subscription.
entitlement_bypass.reason_unsend: Unsending a message requires a Grindr subscription.
entitlement_bypass.reason_album_share: Sharing this album requires a Grindr subscription.
entitlement_bypass.still_refused: Grindr still refused this paid feature
entitlement_bypass.no_location: Set your location before using this bypass
entitlement_bypass.failed: Failed to bypass this paid feature
entitlement_bypass.expiring_album_no_bypass: Expiring albums are a paid Grindr feature, and there's no bypass for them.
entitlement_bypass.reason_expiring_video: Expiring video limit reached. Sending more requires a Grindr subscription.

behavior.default_expiring_photos_free_warning: On the Free plan you can only send a limited number of expiring photos per day. After that, the location bypass (Honduras) is needed, which breaks Grindr's terms of service and can get your account banned.

expiring_allowance.exhausted_bypass: Expiring limit reached. Grindr wants a subscription for more; sending offers the Honduras bypass.

customizability.show_locate_desc: Show "Locate" in the profile menu to estimate a profile's position by triangulation.
